source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/shepherdn/<menu code> for 51 pubs whose own websites link a regular Ten Kites menu (codes in tools/uk_extract/shepherd_neame.py PUBS), 182 tab pages saved 2026-10-11 (skipped tabs: festive, Christmas, Boxing Day, New Year's Eve, murder mystery, buffet, afternoon tea, seafood tower, set menu, function menus, hot drinks / coffee); no date shown on the pages; robots.txt of menus.tenkites.com disallows only /fonts/ /views/ /*.less$. Pub list from the chain's own locator (pubs.shepherdneame.co.uk, 277 pubs).
not_verifiable: the pages show no date or version; 227 of the pub websites link PDF menus (snsites.co.uk, robots.txt disallows *.pdf) and 19 of the 277 pub websites timed out or answered 404, so the 51 pubs are those whose own site links a regular Ten Kites menu, not all 277; the Albion Taverna (Faversham) Ten Kites menu is not used because its website answers 404 and the link could not be confirmed
notes: Re-read with a regex-only parser (no DOM reader, none of the repo's readers) over all 182 saved pages: for every one of the 302 published items every number (kcal, protein, carbs, sugars, fat, saturates, salt) matched the pop-up of at least two pubs (0 items without a matching print, 0 matched at fewer than 2 pubs) and the printed Contains / May contain lines of the matching prints mean the same allergens at every pub. Four pages (royalalbionhotel, parrot, woolpack, bellhotel) were downloaded again the same day with a different User-Agent and compared: 137 prints of published names, 0 differences except two 'Sizzling garlic king prawns' steak-topping rows (274 kcal, a choice row of a build-your-own block, never published; that name is now left out because of it). The live Parrot page was also rendered in headless Chromium (JavaScript on, 166 pop-ups read from the rendered DOM): 78 pop-ups of 39 published dishes, all seven numbers identical. Not published: 290 dishes printed at one pub only, 50 whose figures or allergens differ between pubs, 17 printed twice with different figures (or once as a dish and once as a choice), 931 choice rows (burger toppings, sauces, '- choice' add-ons), 284 rows printing '-', 1 row marked (v)/(vg) in its name whose own 'Suitable for' line says neither. Held back (impossible figures, a one-figure feast, or an allergen row that contradicts the dish name): Acapulco chicken (salt 20.7 g), Tandoori Glory (salt 17.2 g), Mixed pitted Kalamata & Halkidiki olives (sugars above carbohydrate), Tokyo after hours (4406 kcal for a multi-dish feast, serves not stated), Vegan Coconut ice cream (milk contained). marked_ok = the 21 medium audit flags judged as printed: very high salt or protein on sharing platters, boards, 1 kg of wings, a whole lobster and fried-chicken burgers with chips (identical at the pubs that print them), 4 calorie-vs-macro gaps of 15-22% (written into items.csv notes), 'creamy' / 'butter' / 'mayo' in (vg) dish names (the chain's own vegan mark and 'Suitable for: Vegan' line).
